title: Polymarket Liquidity Rewards Scanner
description: Lists Polymarket markets that pay daily liquidity-provider rewards, sorted by USD/day, with qualifying max spread, minimum size and current liquidity. Built for market makers hunting reward pools.

minDailyRewardUsd.title: Minimum daily reward (USD)
minDailyRewardUsd.description: Markets paying less than this amount of rewards per day are dropped.

maxSpreadCents.title: Max allowed spread (cents)
maxSpreadCents.description: Markets whose qualifying max spread is wider than this (in cents) are dropped. Leave empty for no limit.

minLiquidityUsd.title: Minimum liquidity (USD)
minLiquidityUsd.description: Markets with less than this much liquidity are dropped. Use 0 to list everything.

pages.title: Pages to scan (100 markets each)
pages.description: How many pages of Polymarket markets to scan (100 markets per page). Higher values take longer but find more reward pools.

topN.title: Max results
topN.description: Maximum number of markets written to the dataset, sorted by daily reward descending.
